description: This file defines classes related to warning reporting categories, specifically for handling plugin state changes and message length warnings within the WPEFramework. It includes classes for representing long plugin state changes and long message invocations, with serialization, deserialization, and string formatting functionalities.

classes.name: TooLongPluginState
classes.description: Represents a warning category for long plugin state changes, including analysis, serialization, deserialization, and string formatting.

classes.name: TooLongInvokeMessage
classes.description: Represents a warning category for long message handling, supporting different message types, analysis, serialization, deserialization, and string formatting.

methods.name: Analyze
methods.description: Analyzes input data to set internal state based on plugin state change or message content.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the object into a buffer for storage or transmission.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes data from a buffer to reconstruct the object.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Formats the object into a human-readable string.
